title: Prompt Size Warn
description: ENH-2486: emitted when a fully-interpolated action's char size reaches the per-loop prompt_size_guard.warn_chars threshold. WARN-only (does not route); surfaces loops that silently re-embed monotonically growing artifacts.

run_id.description: Run-scoped identity, stable across a run (including pause/resume). Stamped by FSMExecutor._emit()-routed events (ENH-3345) and by every parallel.* emitter (ENH-3346); required on all parallel.* events, optional elsewhere.

loop.description: Loop name whose interpolated action exceeded the threshold

state.description: State name where the oversized action was assembled
